DECISION: Ship Windows in two commits.

PHASE 1 (v1): Whisper only via whisper-rs + vulkan feature flag. Cross-vendor (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel), no extra DLLs, real apps already shipping it. CPU fallback essential.

PHASE 2 (v2): Parakeet via parakeet-rs 0.3.4 + ONNX Runtime + DirectML EP. ~200MB extra DLLs (onnxruntime.dll ~150MB + DirectML.dll ~13MB). Treat as advanced/preview initially.

OPTIONS CONSIDERED: CUDA-only (NVIDIA-only, too narrow), candle/burn (no Parakeet impl), faster-whisper/ct2rs (Windows experimental, CUDA-only), Vulkan-only (chosen for v1).

DEV ENVIRONMENT: macOS with cargo-xwin for cross-compilation + GitHub Actions Windows runner for CI builds. UTM Windows ARM for running/testing artifacts. Ned cannot compile or test locally without this setup.

REVISIT WHEN: If cargo-xwin fully unblocked, may be able to skip CI loop for pure Rust changes.
